calls.title: Growthbook <> Writer - Intro
calls.summary: Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook sales) and Logan Bates (solutions engineer) introduced their feature flagging and experimentation platform to Michelle Cho (Writer's head of data/analytics). Writer is considering alternatives to LaunchDarkly due to high pricing (~$35k) and data trust issues; GrowthBook offers a warehouse-native, transparent approach with integrations to BigQuery/Snowflake. Next steps include Daniel sending a recap email and scheduling a demo with a colleague, with a pricing commitment to stay under $30k.
